remarks: This two-family home on Fourth Street in the heart of Stamford offers a great opportunity for both investors and owner-occupants. The first floor features 2 bedrooms and 1 full bath, while the second floor also has 2 bedrooms plus access to an additional attic space for extra storage or potential expansion. Shared laundry is conveniently located in the basement.
